title: The Examined Life Abroad: Thinking Clearly About Choices That Are Actually Yours
author: Intellectual Encounters editorial project
subject: Philosophy · Reasoning & the good life
description: A short primer on thinking for yourself when family, tradition, and social expectation all push at once — what an argument is, how to tell custom from justification, and how to reason about the choices that shape a life.
